checks.name: algorithm-or-process-linkage
checks.requirement: When the source result concerns an algorithm, recurrence, discretization, or process, the formal statement remains linked to that same construction and execution semantics.

checks.name: norm-metric-and-component-semantics
checks.requirement: Norm, seminorm, metric, squared form, componentwise interpretation, and induced/operator conventions match.

checks.name: error-and-stability-notion
checks.requirement: Forward, backward, mixed, residual, truncation, discretization, conditioning, and stability notions are not substituted for one another.

checks.name: exact-versus-computed-quantities
checks.requirement: Exact, approximate, rounded, perturbed, iterated, and computed quantities retain their source roles.

checks.name: asymptotic-and-higher-order-terms
checks.requirement: Big-O terms, first-order simplifications, exact remainders, limits, and asymptotic regimes are represented with the same logical status.

checks.name: existence-uniqueness-and-well-posedness
checks.requirement: Existence, uniqueness, rank, invertibility, regularity, and well-posedness requirements used by the numerical claim are preserved.
